tickets.title: Branch creation and immutable frontend baseline
acceptance: Record source/report decisions, create/reuse backend branch without overwriting user work and preserve frontend build

tickets.title: Architecture policies and contracts decision record
acceptance: Approve report comparison, modular deployment, versions, currency, state machine, payment capability and signer/evidence assumptions

tickets.title: NestJS and FastAPI health contracts
acceptance: API/AI start with validated env, OpenAPI and correct readiness; no fake health for missing dependencies

tickets.title: PostgreSQL Redis migrations Compose and CI
acceptance: Empty DB migrates; CI boots isolated dependencies; current frontend build remains valid

tickets.title: Outbox worker structured errors observability
acceptance: Committed harmless event survives worker restart and is consumed idempotently; request IDs and redacted logs

tickets.title: Balanced immutable financial journal foundation
acceptance: Posted transactions balance per currency, cannot be mutated, deduplicate commands/events and reserve funds atomically

tickets.title: Unknown provider outcome and late success reconciliation
acceptance: Record external success after client close/cancellation/hold expiry; resolve safely without lost funds or overselling

tickets.title: Live data and demo control eradication audit
acceptance: No production seed reset, universal OTP, fake payment/chat/delivery/AI/serial state or silent fixture fallback remains

tickets.title: Two-account browser and real database concurrency sign-off
acceptance: Persisted artist and rental journeys plus negative permission, last-unit races, callbacks, focus/media/PDF/mobile checks

tickets.title: Staging migration backup restore and rollback rehearsal
acceptance: Images/deployment, DB restore, worker/outbox reconciliation and contract compatible rollback are verified before live activation
